checkpoint_training_corpus.split_method: Human and mouse genomes were divided into 1-Mb regions, syntenically connected components were assigned to train, validation, or test, and 196608-bp examples were derived from those partitions.
checkpoint_training_corpus.training_regime: Cross-species pretraining followed by 30000 human-only fine-tuning steps

current_coloc_gwas.evidence: Enformer was evaluated after training against GTEx v7 summary statistics and GTEx v8 fine-mapped eQTLs, and the paper fit downstream eQTL classifiers. Project GTEx-derived genetic outcomes therefore belong to the downstream-demo task family even though project COLOC memberships were not checkpoint targets.

gse281364.evidence: GSE281364 became public on 2026-03-16, almost four years after the immutable native weight objects. Its HepG2/LX-2 MPRA allele activities and MASLD study labels were not Enformer training targets. Reference sequence at those loci and generic HepG2 tracks were available upstream.

gse289173.evidence: GSE289173 became public on 2025-02-12, after the 2022 native checkpoint. Its 48 donor cell states and signed cell-type eQTL/ieQTL effects were not training targets. hg38 reference windows at its loci and generic liver or hepatocyte tracks may have been seen.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public on 2025-10-01, after the 2022 checkpoint. Its 39-donor same-nucleus RNA/ATAC measurements and QTL outcomes were not checkpoint targets. The public GEO record describes a cardiometabolic liver multiome cohort but does not provide a MASLD diagnosis or histology phenotype for model supervision.

held_out_behavior.donor: Enformer has no donor input. Native predictions are identical for every donor at the same allele and window. Donor grouping applies to any development-fitted track combiner, calibration, enhancer-gene link, or signed-effect head.
held_out_behavior.locus: The pretrained model saw broad hg38 reference sequence, except the native syntenic validation/test components. This is encoder exposure, not outcome-label exposure. Project evaluation still crosses donor folds with merged chromosome/LD blocks and a 196608-bp boundary buffer.
held_out_behavior.sealed: GSE289173 may not choose tracks, bins, TSS anchors, aggregation, link models, direction rules, calibration, or thresholds.

interpretation: Enformer is a sequence-only functional-genomics prior, not a MASLD or donor-context model. All three named project sources postdate the immutable native checkpoint, so their target labels are unexposed. Reference loci and generic liver/HepG2 biology remain exposed and must be handled by genomic blocks and honest domain-language rather than called pristine.

rules.checkpoint_chronology: A donor or experimental outcome public after the immutable 2022 GCS objects is target-label-unexposed unless an upstream source contains the same outcome under another identifier.
rules.conversion_inheritance: A faithful conversion inherits native corpus exposure. Until parity is proven, it also carries conversion uncertainty and cannot improve its exposure classification.
rules.genome_overlap: Reference sequence overlap is encoder exposure. It is controlled with held genomic/LD blocks and the full-window boundary buffer, not misclassified as donor-label contamination.
rules.track_selection: Static liver, HepG2, CAGE, DNase, or ATAC tracks are prespecified with development data only. No sealed label can select or weight a track.
rules.trans_context: Enformer accepts no expression vector. A fixed training track is not observed MASLD context and cannot satisfy an RNA-conditioned endpoint.

task_data_gate.gse281364: Retrospective MPRA direction and rank diagnostic only, with locus-cross-fitted feature selection.
task_data_gate.gse289173: Eligible for one-time sequence inference after selection lock only if checkpoint and terms gates pass; signed eQTL/ieQTL effects remain evaluator-only.
task_data_gate.gse296875: Eligible as development data for static sequence-track baselines or a separately named fitted head; it cannot turn Enformer itself into RNA-conditioned ATAC.
